run_lazyconfig_training: run detectron2 model training using a LazyConfig Python config file with multi-GPU support
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only mode on a detectron2 model using a LazyConfig config file and checkpoint
run_do_train: run the do_train function to instantiate model, optimizer, dataloader, and train with DDP and hooks
run_do_test: run the do_test function to evaluate a model on a test dataset using inference_on_dataset
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that loads LazyConfig, applies overrides, and launches training or evaluation
